source.note: Recorded from the shipped artifact. Where the build and the direction contract disagree, the build is recorded.

display.purpose: The fold headline and the paste heading only. Weight 900, negative tracking, sub-1 line-height. Landing page only; the app shell does not go above the headline size.

headline.purpose: Section headings, and the refusals list which is set at heading scale because the refusals are the copy.

title.purpose: Row headings inside a list: anatomy rows, severity bands, a question.

body.purpose: All prose, capped 52-74ch. Emphasis moves to weight 500-600 rather than a larger size.

document.purpose: Quoted document text only. 0.9375rem on 1.72, justified and hyphenated, held at a 26rem measure so the contract reads small.

label.purpose: Uppercase 900 at 0.13-0.14em: rail section labels, severity words, field keys, the example-document chip. Always a real heading or key, never decoration.

action.purpose: Buttons and the skip link. Uppercase 700 at 0.055em.

shadows.name: left-edge-tab
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system, and not elevation: a zero-blur zero-spread rectangle that draws the ink tab down the left edge of every line fragment of an active source sentence, where a border cannot follow box-decoration-break: clone. Transitions from transparent over 220ms.

motion.name: ease-snap
motion.purpose: The system's only easing curve. Exponential ease-out, used for the entrance and for every state transition.

motion.name: duration-snap
motion.purpose: The authored moment: a flag bar travels from -1.4deg / -1.25rem to true on load. Landing page only.

motion.name: duration-scatter
motion.purpose: Scattered fragments travel from a 1.5rem / -1rem offset to their placed position on load. Landing page only.

motion.name: stagger-snap
motion.purpose: Entrance stagger across the flag bars, cleared once the moment finishes.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Button inversion to ink on hover.

motion.name: duration-mark
motion.purpose: Change-bar underline and tab, and the flag arrow rotation.

motion.name: duration-skip
motion.purpose: The skip link translating into view on focus.

motion.name: app-shell-state-only
motion.purpose: The Operate register. The app shell inherits the easing curve and this range and does NOT inherit the load-time snap or the scatter.

narrative.overview:
A contract is small, plain and businesslike; the warnings that land on it are enormous. The world is built out of one part: a hard-edged rectangle of flat ink. It is the flag bar in the margin, the underline beneath a source sentence, the tab at the head of a question, the marker beside a rail item, the bar in front of a refusal, and the rotated fragment scattered at the edge of a heading. Remove every word and the system is still recognisable by the bar alone.

Nothing here softens. No radius anywhere, no gradient, no glass, no elevation, no decorative shadow, no photography, no illustration, no icon font. The only two-dimensional trick in the build is a colour bar overprinted across heading letterforms with mix-blend-mode: multiply, so the glyphs stay black and the counters fill with ink. Structure is carried by a 2px ink keyline where a boundary matters and a 1px grey hairline where it merely separates.

Density is deliberately uneven, and the unevenness is the argument. Document prose is set at 0.9375rem on a 1.72 line-height at a 26rem measure, justified and hyphenated so it reads as the legal boilerplate it is. Display type runs up to 5.25rem at weight 900 with -0.045em tracking. The reader is meant to feel the size difference between the thing they were handed and the thing being said about it.
keyCharacteristics: One family, Archivo variable 400-900, self-hosted, two subsets, font-display: swap, font-synthesis-weight: none.
Four flat inks plus ink black, cool grey and white. No tints in the palette; the sole mixture in the build is the resting state of a source-sentence underline.
Zero corner radius, zero elevation. Every edge is a cut.
Motion is one authored moment on load, and then the page is still.
Browser chrome is themed: yellow selection, ink scrollbar, ink focus ring, cyan caret.

rules.name: The Identity-Not-Severity Rule
rules.body: Colour tells one flag from another and never encodes how bad it is. Severity is carried by the word ("Critical", "High") and by list order. The page states this rule in its own copy and obeys it: flag 1 is magenta, flag 2 is cyan, flag 3 is yellow, and two of those three are Critical. This is also the WCAG 2.2 AA commitment in PRODUCT.md - severity must never be carried by colour alone. Audit test: recolour every bar at random; if the ranking survives, the rule holds.

rules.name: The Black-On-Every-Ink Rule
rules.body: Black text sits on cyan, magenta, yellow, green, cool grey and white. White text sits only on ink black. White on cyan fails contrast and does not appear in the build. There is no exception and no large-text exemption.

rules.name: The Unmixed Ink Rule
rules.body: Inks are used at full saturation, flat, never gradiented, never overlaid on each other, never given a transparent variant. The one mixture in the shipped build is deliberate and confined: a source-sentence underline rests at 34-40% ink mixed into white and goes to full saturation when its flag is selected, so the at-rest document does not shout. The direction contract said "no tint"; the build ships this one, scoped to that single state.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Type is either small and workmanlike (0.6875-1.125rem) or enormous (1.75rem and up at weight 800-900). The middle is empty on purpose. When a new element needs emphasis, move it to the other register or change weight; do not invent a 1.5rem heading.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Quoted document text is held at 26rem no matter how wide the field gets, because the point is that a contract is small. Everything else caps between 52ch and 74ch.

rules.name: The Overhanging Bar Rule
rules.body: Above 1100px a flag bar breaks its own column by 7rem into the gutter. The bar is not contained by the grid; it lands on the page. Below 1100px it snaps flush, because an overhang with no gutter is just a broken layout.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Section Rule
rules.body: A change of subject is a change of field colour or a 2px keyline across the full width. No section sits inside a centred max-width wrapper, and nothing is ever a card on a background.

rules.name: The Flat-Field Rule
rules.body: No element in this system casts a shadow. box-shadow is permitted only with zero blur and zero spread, as a way of drawing a solid rectangle that a border cannot reach. Any blurred, offset, or lifting shadow is out of world.

dos: Do use colour to tell one flag from another and carry severity in the word and the list order, per The Identity-Not-Severity Rule.
Do set black text on cyan, magenta, yellow, green and cool grey, and reserve white text for ink black.
Do keep every corner square (0 radius) and every edge either a 2px ink keyline or a 1px grey hairline.
Do mark a source sentence with the full change bar - underline, left-edge tab, code chip - and let it clone across wrapped lines.
Do reuse the tab-bar motif whenever a line needs attaching to something, at whatever scale the context wants.
Do run the whole field to full bleed and change the field colour to change the subject.
Do hold quoted document text at a 26rem measure, justified and hyphenated above 520px.
Do use the glossary in CONTEXT.md for every visible word: reader, flag, source sentence, red line, severity, consequence.
Do name a new state in words first. "Critical", "High", "Refused" carry meaning; the bar beside them only identifies.
donts: Don't rank anything by hue, saturation or warmth. A red bar does not mean worse than a yellow one in this system.
Don't put white text on cyan, magenta, yellow or green. It fails AA and the build never does it.
Don't add a gradient, a tint ramp, a translucent overlay, a blur or a glass surface. The single 34-40% mix on a resting source-sentence underline is the whole exception and it does not generalise.
Don't cast a shadow. box-shadow is allowed only at zero blur and zero spread, to draw a solid rectangle.
Don't round a corner, anywhere, at any scale.
Don't add a second typeface, an italic, or a monospace family. Numerals get tabular-nums from Archivo instead.
Don't set display type between 1.125rem and 1.75rem; the ramp is two registers with nothing between them.
Don't introduce an icon font or a glyph character as an icon. Icons are inline SVG symbols with stroke-width 2-2.2 and square caps.

Don't ship a soft-shadowed product screenshot, a feature-card row, a metric strip, or a trust-navy field. The fold's refusal of those shapes is load-bearing: Redline has no metrics and will not borrow the shape of proof.
Don't carry the landing page's scatter-and-snap entrance into the app shell. Inside, motion is 150-250ms and conveys state only.
Don't rotate anything except a scattered fragment or an overprint bar.

carriesToAppShell: the cool-grey rail against a white reading field

knownLimits: Register drift in two sections: the anatomy list and the question box read closer to documentation than to the world the fold establishes. Residual after two finish reviews. A defect the build carries, not a system rule; new surfaces should follow the fold's register.
The overprint bar is applied to exactly two headings. That is an inconsistency in the artifact, not a rule that the device is rare.
#2A2A2E and #5C4A00 are written as literals in the stylesheet rather than declared alongside the other custom properties. Reused and legible, so recorded; they should become :root tokens.
